verdict.rationale: Docs describe general PDF/document ingestion (URL, base64, upload) with no stated size or page limits, implying large documents are supported, but hands-on community testing found that a 900-page document caused a timeout and required manual chunking into smaller pieces — a concrete counter-example to reliable large-document processing. Missing for 10: documented page/size limits, chunking or streaming guidance, retry/timeout handling documentation, and independent confirmation that large multi-gigabyte files process without truncation.
